senses.en: Produce crops, profits, or other results
The amount of a crop, product, or profit produced
Stop resisting, or allow someone else to go first

ex.en: Our apple tree yielded three baskets of fruit.
ex.zh: 我们的苹果树结出了三篮果实。

ex.en: Investment in agricultural research can yield substantial benefits for food security without expanding farmland.
ex.zh: 对农业研究的投资可以在不扩大耕地的情况下，为粮食安全带来显著益处。

tip: yield results指产生结果；yield to指向……让步。

senses.en: To leave someone or something without intending to return.
To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished.
A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.

ex.en: We had to abandon our car in the snow.
ex.zh: 我们不得不将车弃在雪地里。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Completely unreasonable or silly.

ex.en: It seems absurd to drive when the shop is so close.
ex.zh: 商店这么近还要开车去，似乎太不合理了。

ex.en: It is absurd to expect public transport use to increase without improving service quality or affordability.
ex.zh: 不提高服务质量或降低出行成本，却指望公共交通使用量增加，这是不合理的。

tip: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

senses.zh: 滥用；虐待；辱骂；滥用；虐待；辱骂

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records

ex.en: The accountant checked our expenses before we opened the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆开业前，会计核查了我们的各项开支。

ex.en: Employing a qualified accountant helps small businesses manage taxes accurately and make better financial decisions.
ex.zh: 聘用合格的会计师有助于小企业准确处理税务，并作出更好的财务决策。

tip: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Get or become the owner of something.
Develop knowledge or skills through learning or experience.

ex.en: We acquired a secondhand table for our tiny kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们为狭小的厨房添置了一张二手桌子。

ex.en: Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
ex.zh: 实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。

col: an acquired taste｜后天养成的喜好
tip: 比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

senses.en: A difficult or unfortunate situation that causes hardship.

ex.en: Her friends stood beside her throughout years of adversity.
ex.zh: 在多年逆境中，她的朋友一直陪伴在她身边。

ex.en: Strong community networks can help families cope with adversity during periods of economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 在经济前景不明朗的时期，牢固的社区关系网络能帮助家庭应对困境。

col: in the face of adversity｜面对逆境时
tip: 通常为不可数名词，常与face、overcome搭配。

senses.en: To promote products, services or events through public messages.
To announce publicly that someone or something is wanted.

ex.en: The bakery advertises its fresh bread on local radio.
ex.zh: 这家面包店在当地电台为自家的新鲜面包做广告。

ex.en: Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
ex.zh: 政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。

col: advertise a product｜为产品做广告
advertise for staff｜登广告招聘员工
tip: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

senses.en: The activity or business of promoting products and services.

ex.en: My sister works in advertising and designs colourful posters.
ex.zh: 我姐姐从事广告工作，设计色彩鲜艳的海报。

ex.en: Advertising can influence consumer choices, which is why campaigns aimed at children require careful regulation.
ex.zh: 广告会影响消费者的选择，因此针对儿童的广告活动需要受到严格监管。

tip: 通常不可数；一则具体广告用an advertisement。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: drinks containing a substance that can make people drunk
a colourless liquid used in drinks, cleaning products, and fuels

ex.en: This restaurant serves fresh juice but does not sell alcohol.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆供应鲜榨果汁，但不卖酒。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should explain how excessive alcohol consumption can damage both physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应解释过量饮酒如何损害身心健康。

tip: 泛指酒或酒精时通常不可数；a drink可指一杯酒。

senses.en: Someone who pursues an activity for pleasure rather than pay.
Done for enjoyment rather than as a paid profession.
Someone who lacks skill or experience in an activity.

ex.en: Although an amateur, she takes beautiful photographs of birds.
ex.zh: 虽然是业余爱好者，她拍的鸟类照片却很漂亮。

ex.en: Amateur sports clubs provide affordable opportunities for physical activity and help strengthen relationships within local communities.
ex.zh: 业余体育俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，并有助于加强社区居民之间的联系。

tip: amateur通常指非职业者，不一定表示水平低。

senses.zh: 电脑、录像）动画制作；动画片

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Happening once a year or relating to a whole year
A book or magazine published once each year
A plant that completes its life cycle within one year

ex.en: Our annual family picnic was held beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们一年一度的家庭野餐在湖边举行。

ex.en: The annual report provides useful evidence of how public funding has improved local transport services.
ex.zh: 年度报告提供了有用的证据，说明公共资金如何改善了当地交通服务。

tip: annual 表示每年的；annually 是副词，意为每年。

senses.en: Clap your hands to show enjoyment or approval.
Express strong approval of someone or something.

ex.en: Everyone applauded when the young dancer finished her performance.
ex.zh: 年轻舞者表演结束时，所有人都鼓起了掌。

ex.en: Environmental groups applauded the council's decision to protect urban wetlands from further commercial development.
ex.zh: 环保团体赞许市政委员会保护城市湿地、避免其受到进一步商业开发影响的决定。

col: applaud someone's efforts｜称赞某人的努力
tip: 可直接接人或事；applause是不可数名词。

senses.en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time.
The act of choosing someone for a job or position.

ex.en: I have a dental appointment early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我预约了明天一早看牙医。

ex.en: Flexible working hours allow employees to attend medical appointments without taking an entire day off.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间让员工无需请一整天假就能按预约就医。

col: appointment of a director｜董事的任命
tip: 与某人预约用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。

senses.en: A natural ability to learn or do something well

ex.en: Leila showed an aptitude for music at school.
ex.zh: 莱拉在学校里展现出了音乐天赋。

ex.en: Schools should recognise practical aptitude as well as academic achievement when advising students about careers.
ex.zh: 学校在为学生提供职业建议时，既应重视学业成绩，也应认可实践方面的天赋。

col: an aptitude for languages｜语言天赋
show an aptitude for｜展现出某方面的天赋
tip: 常用aptitude for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A curved structure spanning an opening or supporting weight
To bend into a curved shape

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain beneath a stone arch.
ex.zh: 我们在一座石拱门下避雨。

ex.en: Traditional bridges often use a central arch to distribute weight and allow boats to pass beneath.
ex.zh: 传统桥梁常用中央拱形结构来分散重量，并让船只从下方通过。

tip: 作动词表示弯成拱形，如arch your back。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 亚里土多德(古希腊哲学家)

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority
the act of taking someone into police custody
to stop the progress or development of something

ex.en: Police arrested the suspect outside the station yesterday.
ex.zh: 警方昨天在车站外逮捕了嫌疑人。

ex.en: Early investment in building maintenance can arrest the decline of historic neighbourhoods and preserve their distinctive character.
ex.zh: 尽早投入建筑维护资金可以遏制历史街区的衰落，并保留其独特风貌。

col: arrest someone for theft｜因盗窃逮捕某人
tip: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。

senses.en: a pointed symbol showing direction
a thin pointed object shot from a bow

ex.en: Follow the arrow on the floor to the exit.
ex.zh: 沿着地板上的箭头走到出口。

ex.en: Clear arrows on station floors can improve passenger flow and reduce confusion during busy commuting periods.
ex.zh: 车站地面上清晰的箭头可以改善客流，减少通勤高峰期的混乱。

col: follow the arrow｜沿箭头方向走
an arrow points to｜箭头指向
tip: arrow既指弓射出的“箭”，也指示方向的“箭头”。

senses.en: Related to art or the creation of art
Good at creating or appreciating art
Beautiful or attractive in a way that shows creative skill

ex.en: The festival celebrates artistic traditions through music and dance.
ex.zh: 这个节日通过音乐和舞蹈颂扬艺术传统。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for artistic expression, as creative activities can support emotional development and cultural understanding.
ex.zh: 学校应提供艺术表达的机会，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和文化理解。

tip: artistic指艺术或艺术天赋；artificial指人造的。

senses.en: to join separate parts together to make something
to gather together or bring people or things together

ex.en: We assembled the bookshelf before putting our books away.
ex.zh: 我们先组装好书架，再把书收好。

ex.en: Manufacturers increasingly use robots to assemble electronic devices, improving consistency while reducing demand for some manual jobs.
ex.zh: 制造商越来越多地使用机器人组装电子设备，在提高一致性的同时减少了对某些体力岗位的需求。

col: assemble in the hall｜在大厅集合
tip: 组装物品时及物；表示人集合时也可不及物。

senses.en: To give someone a task, role, or resource
To give something a particular value or category

ex.en: The coach assigned each player a partner for practice.
ex.zh: 教练给每位队员安排了一名训练搭档。

ex.en: Teachers should assign tasks that match students' abilities while encouraging them to develop new skills.
ex.zh: 教师应布置符合学生能力的任务，同时鼓励他们培养新技能。

col: assign someone to a team｜将某人分配到团队
tip: 常用assign sth to sb，也可用assign sb sth。

senses.en: To wait for someone or something
To be ready or likely to happen to someone

ex.en: We eagerly await the arrival of our new puppy.
ex.zh: 我们热切地等待着新来的小狗到家。

ex.en: Many graduates await job offers while developing additional skills through voluntary work and online courses.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生在等待录用通知期间，通过志愿工作和在线课程学习更多技能。

tip: 较正式，直接接宾语；不要写await for。

senses.en: Towards the back, or with the back facing forwards.
In the opposite order or direction to the usual one.

ex.en: She stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
ex.zh: 她向后退了一步，让骑车的人过去。

ex.en: Researchers can work backwards from current pollution levels to identify the likely sources of environmental damage.
ex.zh: 研究人员可以根据当前污染水平反向追溯，找出环境破坏的可能来源。

tip: backwards是副词；修饰名词通常用backward。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a place where bread and cakes are made or sold

ex.en: The bakery near our house sells warm bread every morning.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的面包店每天早上都卖热乎乎的面包。

ex.en: Small businesses such as bakeries provide local employment and help maintain vibrant neighbourhood shopping areas.
ex.zh: 面包店等小企业提供本地就业岗位，也有助于保持社区商业区的活力。

tip: bakery指店铺或制作场所；烘焙食品用baked goods。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire.
Equipment for cooking food over a fire outdoors.
To cook food on a grill over a fire.

ex.en: We invited our neighbours to a barbecue in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们邀请邻居来花园参加烧烤聚餐。

ex.en: Designated barbecue areas allow visitors to cook outdoors while reducing the risk of fires in public parks.
ex.zh: 指定烧烤区既能让游客在户外烹饪，也能降低公园发生火灾的风险。

col: have a barbecue｜举办烧烤聚餐
tip: 既指烧烤聚餐或烤架，也可作动词；常缩写为BBQ。

senses.en: Unable to support much plant growth.
Producing nothing useful or lacking something important.

ex.en: Only a few bushes grew on the barren hillside.
ex.zh: 贫瘠的山坡上只长着几丛灌木。

ex.en: Unsustainable farming can turn productive fields into barren land, threatening food security and forcing rural communities to relocate.
ex.zh: 不可持续的耕作方式会使良田变成荒地，威胁粮食安全，并迫使农村社区迁移。

tip: barren强调不生长或无产出；bare强调裸露、无遮挡。

senses.en: A wide, open container for water or washing.
The land drained by a river and its smaller rivers.
A broad area of low land surrounded by higher ground.

ex.en: She filled the basin with water to wash her face.
ex.zh: 她往盆里倒满水，准备洗脸。

ex.en: Agricultural expansion across the river basin has increased pressure on freshwater supplies and damaged natural habitats.
ex.zh: 整个流域内的农业扩张加大了淡水供应压力，并破坏了自然栖息地。

tip: river basin指整个流域，不只是河道。

senses.en: Hair growing on a person's chin and cheeks.

ex.en: He trimmed his beard before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 他上班出门前修剪了胡须。

ex.en: In some workplaces, employees with beards must use special coverings to maintain food hygiene standards.
ex.zh: 在一些工作场所，蓄胡须的员工必须佩戴专用罩具，以符合食品卫生标准。

tip: beard指下巴及两颊胡须；moustache指上唇胡须。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: having a sharp taste like strong unsweetened coffee
angry and resentful because of unfair treatment or disappointment
involving strong anger and hostility

ex.en: The coffee tasted too bitter without milk or sugar.
ex.zh: 这咖啡不加奶或糖，喝起来太苦了。

ex.en: Proposals to close local libraries have sparked bitter disputes between residents and local authorities.
ex.zh: 关闭当地图书馆的提议引发了居民与地方政府之间的激烈争议。

tip: 味觉上的bitter是苦，sour是酸，别混淆。

senses.en: having no writing, pictures, or other content
showing no understanding, feeling, or recognition
an empty space where information should be added

ex.en: She handed me a blank sheet and some pencils.
ex.zh: 她递给我一张白纸和几支铅笔。

ex.en: A blank page can encourage creative thinking by allowing learners to organise ideas without a fixed template.
ex.zh: 空白页面让学习者无需固定模板就能组织想法，从而有助于激发创造性思维。

tip: go blank可指脑中突然一片空白、想不起来。

senses.en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something.
Applying to everyone or everything without considering individual differences.
To cover something completely with a layer.

ex.en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她用一条柔软的毯子裹住冰凉的肩膀。

ex.en: A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.
ex.zh: 全面禁止私家车可能使难以使用公共交通的居民处于不利地位。

col: a blanket of snow｜厚厚的一层雪
tip: blanket作形容词指全面适用，如blanket ban。

senses.en: a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush
to produce flowers
to develop successfully or become more confident

ex.en: Pink blossom covered the cherry tree outside our kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房外的樱桃树开满了粉红色的花。

ex.en: Creative talent can blossom when schools provide supportive teaching and regular opportunities for artistic expression.
ex.zh: 学校提供支持性的教学和经常性的艺术表达机会时，创造性才能便能蓬勃发展。

tip: 多指树木的花；blossom into可比喻成长为。

senses.zh: 模糊不清的；难以区分的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a close connection between people or groups
an investment representing a loan with promised repayment and interest
to develop a close relationship or join things firmly together

ex.en: Caring for the puppy strengthened the bond between the sisters.
ex.zh: 照顾小狗加深了姐妹之间的感情。

ex.en: Governments often issue bonds to finance major infrastructure projects without immediately increasing taxes on households.
ex.zh: 政府经常发行债券，为大型基础设施项目筹资，而不立即提高家庭税负。

col: form a bond｜建立亲密关系
tip: bond with sb指增进感情；issue bonds指发行债券。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: move back up after hitting a surface, or cause this
a movement back up after hitting a surface
be rejected by a bank because funds are insufficient

ex.en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
ex.zh: 球弹过篱笆，落进了邻居的花园。

ex.en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
ex.zh: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。

col: bounce ideas off someone｜与某人交流想法
tip: bounce back既可指弹回，也常指受挫后恢复。

senses.en: a game of rolling a heavy ball to knock down pins
the action of delivering the ball towards a cricket batter

ex.en: My cousins and I went bowling on Saturday.
ex.zh: 星期六，我和表兄弟姐妹一起去打保龄球了。

ex.en: Leisure centres offering activities such as bowling can encourage social interaction among people of different ages.
ex.zh: 提供保龄球等活动的休闲中心能够促进不同年龄人群之间的社交互动。

tip: 保龄球运动用go bowling；也可指板球中的投球。

senses.zh: 黄铜；黄铜制品；铜管乐器

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An important discovery or advance that overcomes a difficult problem.

ex.en: After weeks of practice, I finally made a breakthrough.
ex.zh: 练习了几周后，我终于取得了突破。

ex.en: A breakthrough in battery technology could make renewable energy more reliable and affordable for households.
ex.zh: 电池技术的突破可能使可再生能源对家庭而言更加可靠、更加经济。

col: breakthrough in treatment｜治疗方面的突破
tip: 名词写成一个词；动词短语break through分开写。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.

ex.en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
ex.zh: 新娘手捧鲜花走进花园。

ex.en: In many cultures, the bride and her family share responsibility for organising the wedding celebration.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，新娘及其家人共同负责筹办婚礼庆典。

tip: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To transmit programmes through radio, television, or the internet.
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The station broadcasts local news every morning before breakfast.
ex.zh: 这家电台每天早晨早餐前播报本地新闻。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: a round pocket of gas inside liquid or a thin film
to produce bubbles or make a sound as bubbles rise
a period when asset prices rise beyond their real value

ex.en: A huge soap bubble floated gently above the garden.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的肥皂泡轻轻飘在花园上方。

ex.en: A housing bubble can leave families with heavy debts when property prices suddenly fall.
ex.zh: 当房价突然下跌时，房地产泡沫可能使家庭背上沉重债务。

tip: bubble既指气泡，也可比喻资产价格泡沫。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: an adult male animal of the cattle family
an investor who expects market prices to rise

ex.en: A large bull stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一头大公牛静静地站在农场门旁。

ex.en: During a bull market, rising share prices may encourage households to invest more of their savings.
ex.zh: 在牛市期间，股价上涨可能促使家庭将更多储蓄用于投资。

col: take the bull by the horns｜勇敢面对难题
tip: 金融中bull指看涨者，与bear（看跌者）相对。

senses.en: A strong stretchy cord used for securing objects or bungee jumping.

ex.en: We secured the sleeping bags with a strong bungee.
ex.zh: 我们用一根结实的弹力绳固定住了睡袋。

ex.en: Adventure tourism operators must inspect every bungee cord regularly to ensure that essential safety standards are maintained.
ex.zh: 探险旅游经营者必须定期检查每根蹦极绳，以确保符合基本安全标准。

tip: bungee主要指弹力绳；蹦极运动通常说bungee jumping。

senses.en: someone who prepares and sells meat
to kill animals for meat or cut up their meat
to do something very badly, spoiling the result

ex.en: The butcher wrapped our chicken and suggested a simple recipe.
ex.zh: 肉贩把我们的鸡肉包好，还推荐了一个简单的做法。

ex.en: A local butcher can help customers reduce food waste by recommending suitable cuts and portion sizes.
ex.zh: 当地肉贩可以推荐合适的肉块和分量，帮助顾客减少食物浪费。

col: butcher a song｜把一首歌唱砸
tip: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 有组织的运动；宣传活动
senses.en: A series of organised activities aimed at achieving a goal
To organise or take part in activities supporting a cause
A series of military operations with a particular objective

ex.en: Our school launched a campaign to reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 我们学校发起了一项减少食物浪费的活动。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can encourage healthier habits, especially when supported by affordable access to nutritious food.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传活动能促进更健康的习惯，尤其是在居民能够负担并获得营养食物的情况下。

col: an advertising campaign｜广告宣传活动
campaign for reform｜为改革开展运动
campaign against pollution｜开展反污染运动
tip: 动词后接for表示争取，接against表示反对。

senses.en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water
a narrow passage inside the body

ex.en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘窄船沿运河缓缓驶过。

ex.en: Restoring historic canals can attract tourists while providing valuable habitats for wildlife in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 修复历史悠久的运河既能吸引游客，也能为人口密集城区的野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。

senses.en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position.
Someone taking an examination.

ex.en: Each candidate waited outside the office before their interview.
ex.zh: 每位求职者都在面试前等候在办公室外。

ex.en: Employers should assess each candidate fairly rather than rely on assumptions about their educational or cultural background.
ex.zh: 雇主应公平评估每位求职者，而不是依赖对其教育或文化背景的主观推断。

col: candidate for a position｜某职位的候选人
tip: candidate for后接所竞聘的职位或所竞选的职务。

senses.en: the maximum amount something can hold or accommodate
the ability or resources to do or produce something
a particular role in which someone acts

ex.en: This small lift has a capacity of six people.
ex.zh: 这部小电梯最多能容纳六个人。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can expand electricity generation capacity while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以扩大发电能力，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

col: in a professional capacity｜以专业人士身份
tip: 能力用capacity to do；身份用in one's capacity as。

senses.en: a small soluble case containing medicine that you swallow
a small enclosed compartment carrying people or equipment in space

ex.en: The pharmacist told me to swallow the capsule with water.
ex.zh: 药剂师告诉我要用水吞服这粒胶囊。

ex.en: The space capsule was designed to protect its crew from extreme temperatures during their return to Earth.
ex.zh: 这艘太空舱的设计旨在保护乘员，使其返回地球时免受极端高温的伤害。

tip: 药物capsule有外壳；tablet通常是压制成的药片。

senses.en: A chemical element present in all living things.

ex.en: Diamonds and the graphite in pencils both contain carbon.
ex.zh: 钻石和铅笔里的石墨都含有碳。

ex.en: Protecting forests helps store carbon and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护森林有助于储存碳，并减少释放到大气中的二氧化碳。

tip: carbon是碳元素；carbon dioxide才是二氧化碳。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Made from clay or similar materials hardened by heat.
A material hardened by heat, or an object made from it.

ex.en: She keeps fresh flowers in a blue ceramic vase.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插在一个蓝色陶瓷花瓶里。

ex.en: Ceramic tiles are widely used in public buildings because they are durable and relatively easy to clean.
ex.zh: 陶瓷砖耐用且较易清洁，因此广泛用于公共建筑。

tip: ceramics可指陶瓷制品，也可指陶艺或陶瓷工艺。

senses.en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.

ex.en: Lena proudly showed her swimming certificate to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 莉娜自豪地向祖父母展示了她的游泳证书。

ex.en: A professional certificate can improve employment prospects, but employers also value practical experience.
ex.zh: 专业资格证书可以改善就业前景，但雇主也重视实践经验。

col: a professional certificate｜专业资格证书
tip: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

senses.en: A woman who leads a meeting, committee, or organisation.

ex.en: The chairwoman invited everyone to share their ideas.
ex.zh: 女主席邀请大家分享各自的想法。

ex.en: The chairwoman proposed new training programmes to improve employees' skills and support equal opportunities.
ex.zh: 女董事长提议开展新的培训项目，以提升员工技能并促进机会平等。

col: chairwoman of the board｜董事会女主席
tip: 复数为chairwomen；不强调性别可用chair。

senses.en: A television service or route for communicating and distributing things
A passage of water connecting areas or allowing boats through
Direct energy, money, or resources towards a particular purpose

ex.en: Could you change the channel before the film starts?
ex.zh: 电影开始前，你能换个频道吗？

ex.en: Governments should channel more funding into public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资金投入公共交通，以缓解拥堵并便利人们上班求职。

tip: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。

senses.en: a state of complete confusion and lack of order

ex.en: The kitchen was in chaos after we baked together.
ex.zh: 我们一起烘焙后，厨房里一片狼藉。

ex.en: Unexpected road closures caused chaos across the city, highlighting the need for better emergency planning.
ex.zh: 突如其来的道路封闭使全市陷入混乱，凸显了完善应急规划的必要性。

tip: 不可数名词；ch发/k/，不是/tʃ/。

senses.en: A small round fruit with a stone and usually red skin
A tree grown for its cherries or attractive blossoms

ex.en: He placed a ripe cherry on top of the cake.
ex.zh: 他在蛋糕顶上放了一颗熟透的樱桃。

ex.en: Cherry trees attract visitors during spring, providing seasonal income for rural communities through tourism.
ex.zh: 樱花树在春季吸引游客，通过旅游业为乡村社区带来季节性收入。

tip: 复数为cherries；果核用stone（英）或pit（美）。

senses.en: A repeated section of a song, usually with unchanged words.
A group singing together, or many voices sounding together.
To say or sing something together at the same time.

ex.en: Everyone joined in when the song reached its chorus.
ex.zh: 歌曲唱到副歌时，大家都跟着唱了起来。

ex.en: A memorable chorus can help environmental campaign songs reach wider audiences and encourage participation in community activities.
ex.zh: 令人难忘的副歌可以帮助环保宣传歌曲吸引更广泛的听众，并鼓励人们参与社区活动。

col: join in the chorus｜加入副歌合唱
a chorus of approval｜一片赞同声
tip: 歌曲的chorus是反复出现的副歌，与verse主歌相对。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.

ex.en: He refused a cigarette and went for a walk instead.
ex.zh: 他拒绝了递来的香烟，转而出去散步。

ex.en: Higher cigarette taxes may discourage smoking, but accessible support services are also essential for people trying to quit.
ex.zh: 提高香烟税可能有助于减少吸烟，但对尝试戒烟的人来说，便捷的支持服务也必不可少。

col: a packet of cigarettes｜一包香烟
tip: 可数名词；一包香烟可说a packet of cigarettes。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A connected path through which an electric current can flow
A route around an area, or one journey around it
A series of places visited for similar events or activities

ex.en: The bulb lit up when we completed the circuit.
ex.zh: 我们接通电路后，灯泡亮了。

ex.en: Students can develop practical scientific skills by building a simple circuit and testing different materials.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过搭建简单电路并测试不同材料来培养科学实践技能。

tip: 电路和环形路线都可用circuit；short circuit指短路。

senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

ex.en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
ex.zh: 我们看着马戏演员抛接色彩鲜艳的球。

ex.en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
ex.zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。

tip: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。

senses.en: Relating to citizens or ordinary society rather than the military.
Relating to private legal disputes rather than criminal offences.
Polite and respectful, though not necessarily friendly.

ex.en: The airport handles both military and civil aircraft.
ex.zh: 这座机场既接待军用飞机，也接待民用飞机。

ex.en: Protecting civil rights requires accessible legal services and public institutions that treat all citizens fairly.
ex.zh: 保护公民权利需要便捷可及的法律服务，以及公平对待所有公民的公共机构。

tip: civil law指民法；civil war则指内战。

senses.en: A person who is not a member of the armed forces
Relating to people or activities outside the armed forces

ex.en: The rescue boat carried both soldiers and civilians.
ex.zh: 救援船上既有军人，也有平民。

ex.en: Satellite technology originally developed for military purposes now supports many civilian applications, including weather forecasting and navigation.
ex.zh: 最初为军事目的开发的卫星技术，如今支持天气预报和导航等多种民用应用。

tip: civilian指非军人；公务员通常是civil servant。

senses.en: someone who pays for professional services
a computer or program using services from a server

ex.en: The designer showed her client three possible kitchen layouts.
ex.zh: 设计师向客户展示了三种可选的厨房布局。

ex.en: Maintaining clear communication with each client helps businesses build trust and establish lasting professional relationships.
ex.zh: 与每位客户保持清晰的沟通有助于企业建立信任，并形成持久的业务关系。

tip: client常购买专业服务；customer泛指购买商品或服务的人。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Symbols or instructions representing information, including instructions for computers
A set of rules governing behaviour or practice
Write computer instructions or convert information into a coded form

ex.en: I forgot the code for my bicycle lock again.
ex.zh: 我又忘了自行车锁的密码。

ex.en: Teaching students to write code can strengthen problem-solving skills and prepare them for a changing job market.
ex.zh: 教学生编写代码可以增强解决问题的能力，帮助他们适应不断变化的就业市场。

tip: 程序代码通常不可数；一组密码可说a code。

senses.en: The part of a garment that surrounds the neck.
A band worn around an animal's neck.
To catch or stop someone, often to speak to them.

ex.en: He straightened his shirt collar before the interview.
ex.zh: 面试前，他整理了一下衬衫衣领。

ex.en: A well-fitted collar allows owners to attach a lead and keep dogs under control in public spaces.
ex.zh: 合适的颈圈方便主人系上牵引绳，在公共场所管好狗。

col: turn up your collar｜竖起衣领
tip: white-collar指白领的；blue-collar指蓝领的。

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。

ex.en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
ex.zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。

tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

senses.en: A strong willingness to give time and effort to something.
A firm promise to do something.
A duty or arrangement requiring your time, money, or attention.

ex.en: Her commitment to gardening keeps the flowers blooming.
ex.zh: 她用心打理花园，让鲜花一直盛开。

ex.en: Improving public transport requires sustained political commitment and reliable funding rather than occasional investment in isolated projects.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通需要持续的政治决心和可靠的资金，而非偶尔投资零散项目。

col: commitment to a cause｜对事业的投入
tip: commitment to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.zh: 共产主义的；共产主义者(；与……冲突或抵触

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Having many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or manage.

ex.en: This recipe is too complicated for a quick lunch.
ex.zh: 这道菜的做法太复杂，不适合赶时间做午饭。

ex.en: Complicated application procedures may discourage eligible students from seeking financial support for their university studies.
ex.zh: 复杂的申请程序可能使符合条件的学生不愿申请大学学业资助。

tip: 强调复杂难懂；complex也可仅指结构复杂。

senses.en: To create music or carefully write a piece of writing
To be the parts that together form a whole
To calm yourself and regain control of your emotions

ex.en: She composed a short tune on her old piano.
ex.zh: 她用自己的旧钢琴创作了一段短曲。

ex.en: Students who compose their own music can develop creativity while gaining a deeper understanding of musical structure.
ex.zh: 自己作曲的学生既能培养创造力，也能加深对音乐结构的理解。

tip: be composed of表示“由……组成”。

senses.en: The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.

ex.en: Drawing a simple diagram helped my comprehension of the instructions.
ex.zh: 画一张简单的图帮助我理解了操作说明。

ex.en: Regular exposure to varied reading materials can improve students' comprehension and expand their academic vocabulary.
ex.zh: 经常接触多样的阅读材料可以提高学生的理解力，并扩充其学术词汇。

tip: 通常不可数；comprehensive意为“全面的”。

senses.en: Covering all or nearly all important parts of something.

ex.en: This comprehensive guide covers every trail in the park.
ex.zh: 这本详尽的指南涵盖了公园里的每条步道。

ex.en: Schools should provide comprehensive health education to help students make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 学校应提供全面的健康教育，帮助学生对自己的生活方式作出明智决定。

tip: 强调涵盖范围全面，不是指容易理解。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the protection of wildlife and natural environments
careful use of resources to avoid waste
the protection and repair of valuable old objects or buildings

ex.en: Our class joined a conservation project to protect local frogs.
ex.zh: 我们班参加了一个保护当地青蛙的自然保护项目。

ex.en: Successful wildlife conservation requires cooperation between local communities, researchers, and governments over many years.
ex.zh: 成功的野生动物保护需要当地社区、研究人员和政府长期合作。

tip: 通常不可数；可指保护自然，也可指节约能源。

senses.en: An expert paid to provide specialist advice.
A senior hospital doctor specialising in a particular medical field.

ex.en: We hired a consultant to help improve our small business.
ex.zh: 我们聘请了一位顾问，帮助改善小公司的经营。

ex.en: An environmental consultant can help companies reduce waste while ensuring that their operations comply with national regulations.
ex.zh: 环境顾问可以帮助企业减少废弃物，同时确保其运营符合国家法规。

col: a consultant surgeon｜高级外科医生
tip: 医疗语境中，英国的consultant指高级专科医生。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Belonging to the present time.
Existing or happening during the same period.
A person who lives at the same time as another.

ex.en: The gallery displays contemporary paintings in bright, spacious rooms.
ex.zh: 这家画廊在明亮宽敞的展厅里陈列当代绘画。

ex.en: Contemporary architecture increasingly incorporates natural materials to reduce environmental impact and improve the wellbeing of occupants.
ex.zh: 当代建筑越来越多地采用天然材料，以减少环境影响并改善居住者的身心健康。

col: a contemporary of someone｜与某人同时代的人
tip: 当代艺术中指“当代”；历史语境也可指“当时的”。

senses.en: A legally binding agreement between people or organisations.
To become smaller or make something smaller.
To catch or develop a disease.

ex.en: Read the contract carefully before you agree to sign it.
ex.zh: 同意签字之前，要仔细阅读合同。

ex.en: A clear employment contract protects both workers and employers by defining responsibilities, working hours and payment terms.
ex.zh: 明确的劳动合同通过规定职责、工作时间和薪酬条款，保护员工和雇主双方的权益。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。

senses.zh: 表达；传递（思想、感情等）；传送

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the central or most important part of something
central and essential to something
to remove the hard central part of a fruit

ex.en: She ate the apple and threw away the core.
ex.zh: 她吃完苹果，把果核扔掉了。

ex.en: Critical thinking should be a core skill taught in schools because it helps students evaluate information independently.
ex.zh: 批判性思维应成为学校教授的核心技能，因为它有助于学生独立评估信息。

col: at the core of｜处于……的核心
tip: 果核指苹果等的中央硬部；桃核通常用stone。

senses.en: Relating to a company or businesses in general.
Shared by a group acting together as one body.

ex.en: My sister handles corporate travel for a small company.
ex.zh: 我姐姐为一家小公司安排商务差旅。

ex.en: Greater corporate transparency allows consumers to assess whether businesses genuinely meet their environmental and social commitments.
ex.zh: 提高企业透明度能让消费者判断企业是否真正履行了环境和社会承诺。

tip: corporate指企业的；cooperative指合作的。

senses.en: To match something or have an equivalent role or position.
To exchange letters or messages with someone.

ex.en: The colours on these lids correspond to the containers.
ex.zh: 这些盖子的颜色与各自的容器相对应。

ex.en: University courses should correspond more closely to the skills that employers need in a changing economy.
ex.zh: 在不断变化的经济中，大学课程应与雇主所需的技能更加契合。

tip: 对应常用correspond to；与人通信接with。

senses.en: Written communication between people, or the messages they exchange.
A close similarity or connection between two things.

ex.en: She keeps her correspondence with her cousin in a drawer.
ex.zh: 她把与表亲的往来信件放在抽屉里。

ex.en: Historical correspondence can reveal how ordinary families experienced social changes that official records describe only briefly.
ex.zh: 历史上的往来信件能揭示普通家庭如何经历官方记录仅简略提及的社会变迁。

col: correspondence with someone｜与某人的通信
tip: 表示往来信件时不可数；与某人通信用with。

senses.en: warm, comfortable, and pleasant, often in a small space
friendly and relaxed in a private setting

ex.en: We spent a cosy evening beside the fire.
ex.zh: 我们在炉火旁度过了一个温暖惬意的夜晚。

ex.en: Small libraries can provide cosy spaces where residents read, relax, and build connections with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 小型图书馆可以提供舒适的空间，让居民阅读、放松并与邻里建立联系。

col: a cosy room｜温暖舒适的房间
tip: 英式拼写cosy，美式通常写cozy。

senses.en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric.
Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.

ex.en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
ex.zh: 这件棉衬衫洗了很多次后摸起来仍然很柔软。

ex.en: Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.
ex.zh: 棉花生产会给供水带来相当大的压力，尤其是在降雨量有限的地区。

tip: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。

senses.en: A group chosen to govern an area or manage affairs.

ex.en: The local council repaired the playground near our house.
ex.zh: 地方议会修好了我们家附近的游乐场。

ex.en: The city council should consult residents before approving developments that could affect public green spaces.
ex.zh: 市议会在批准可能影响公共绿地的开发项目之前，应征询居民意见。

tip: council指议会或委员会；counsel指建议或劝告。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft
A group working together on a particular practical task
Work as a member of a boat's crew

ex.en: The crew welcomed us aboard with warm smiles.
ex.zh: 机组人员面带亲切的笑容，欢迎我们登机。

ex.en: Airlines must ensure that every crew member receives regular safety training to protect passengers during emergencies.
ex.zh: 航空公司必须确保每位机组成员定期接受安全培训，以便在紧急情况下保护乘客。

tip: crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。

senses.en: A standard used to judge something or make a decision.

ex.en: Price was my main criterion when choosing a bicycle.
ex.zh: 选自行车时，价格是我的主要衡量标准。

ex.en: Environmental impact should be a key criterion when governments assess proposals for new transport infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府评估新交通基础设施提案时，应将环境影响作为重要标准。

col: meet a criterion｜符合一项标准
tip: 单数criterion，复数criteria；不能说a criteria。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings.
Causing great suffering or disappointment.

ex.en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
ex.zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。

ex.en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
ex.zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。

col: be cruel to animals｜虐待动物
tip: 表示对某人或动物残忍，用be cruel to。

senses.zh: 毁坏；压坏；压碎；拥挤的人群

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An art style showing subjects through geometric shapes and multiple viewpoints.

ex.en: We explored cubism by painting faces with overlapping geometric shapes.
ex.zh: 我们用重叠的几何图形画人脸，探索立体主义风格。

ex.en: Cubism challenged traditional artistic representation by presenting multiple viewpoints within a single image rather than imitating natural appearances.
ex.zh: 立体主义在同一幅图像中呈现多个视角，而非模仿自然外观，从而挑战了传统艺术表现方式。

col: the development of cubism｜立体主义的发展
tip: 通常不可数；cubist 可指立体派艺术家或作形容词。

senses.zh: 提示；暗示；信号；给（某人）暗示（或提示

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A cabinet with doors and shelves for storing things

ex.en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
ex.zh: 干净的碗放在水槽上方的橱柜里。

ex.en: Well-designed cupboards can maximise storage space in small apartments without making living areas feel crowded.
ex.zh: 设计合理的橱柜可以充分利用小公寓的储物空间，又不会让起居区域显得拥挤。

tip: cupboard中的p不发音；通常指带门的储物柜。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way.
Unwanted moisture in the air, walls, or other surfaces.
To make slightly wet or reduce strength or activity.

ex.en: My socks are still damp from yesterday's walk.
ex.zh: 昨天散步后，我的袜子到现在还潮乎乎的。

ex.en: Living in damp conditions can worsen respiratory problems, particularly among children and older people.
ex.zh: 居住环境潮湿可能加重呼吸系统问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受影响。

col: rising damp｜沿墙上升的地面湿气
tip: damp多指令人不适的微湿；moist可用于食物润泽。

senses.en: the early morning when daylight first appears
the beginning of a new period or development
to become understood, or to begin growing light

ex.en: We left at dawn to avoid the heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 我们黎明时就出发了，以避开拥堵的交通。

ex.en: The dawn of digital communication has transformed how people maintain relationships across national borders.
ex.zh: 数字通信时代的到来改变了人们跨国维系人际关系的方式。

col: from dawn to dusk｜从早到晚
the dawn of a new era｜新时代的开端
dawn on someone｜使某人开始明白
tip: It dawned on me that…表示“我开始明白……”。

senses.en: The latest time by which something must be completed

ex.en: I stayed up late to meet the application deadline.
ex.zh: 我熬夜赶在截止日期前完成了申请。

ex.en: Setting a realistic deadline allows researchers to maintain quality without delaying the publication of important findings.
ex.zh: 设定合理的截止日期能让研究人员保证质量，同时不耽误重要发现的发表。

col: miss a deadline｜错过截止期限
extend a deadline｜延长截止期限
a tight deadline｜紧迫的截止期限
tip: 按期完成用meet a deadline，不用catch。

senses.en: Money owed to a person, bank, or other organisation.
A feeling of owing gratitude for help someone has given.

ex.en: She took an extra shift to pay off her debt.
ex.zh: 她多上了一个班来还清欠款。

ex.en: High levels of household debt can reduce consumer spending and make an economy more vulnerable to recession.
ex.zh: 家庭债务水平过高会抑制消费支出，使经济更容易受到衰退冲击。

col: pay off a debt｜还清债务
a debt of gratitude｜感激之情
tip: b不发音；in debt表示负债。

senses.en: of a satisfactory or reasonably good standard
honest, kind, or socially acceptable

ex.en: We finally found a decent flat near the station.
ex.zh: 我们终于在车站附近找到了一套像样的公寓。

ex.en: Every worker should earn enough to afford decent housing and meet their basic needs.
ex.zh: 每位劳动者都应有足够的收入，住上像样的住房并满足基本需求。

tip: 表示质量时是“还不错”，不等于“极好”。

senses.en: to announce something publicly or officially
to officially report goods, income or other required information

ex.en: The judges declared her the winner of the competition.
ex.zh: 评委宣布她赢得了比赛。

ex.en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。

col: declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态
tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

senses.en: To become smaller, weaker, or less successful.
A reduction in amount, strength, quality, or importance.
To politely refuse an offer, invitation, or request.

ex.en: I thanked her for dinner but declined the invitation.
ex.zh: 我感谢她邀我吃饭，但婉拒了邀请。

ex.en: As public transport improves, private car use may decline, reducing congestion and air pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 随着公共交通改善，私家车使用量可能下降，从而缓解城市拥堵和空气污染。

col: a decline in sales｜销售额下降
tip: 下降用decline in；婉拒做某事用decline to do。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To remove written material or stored information.

ex.en: Please delete those blurry photos from my phone.
ex.zh: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。

ex.en: Online services should allow users to delete their personal data when they no longer need an account.
ex.zh: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。

tip: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

senses.en: Easily damaged or harmed.
Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence.
Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.

ex.en: Please wrap these delicate glass bowls in soft paper.
ex.zh: 请用柔软的纸包好这些易碎的玻璃碗。

ex.en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。

col: delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

senses.en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.

ex.en: You deserve a rest after carrying those heavy boxes.
ex.zh: 搬了那些沉重的箱子后，你该休息一下了。

ex.en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
ex.zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a very hard mineral used in jewellery and cutting tools
a shape with four equal sides and opposite angles equal

ex.en: A tiny diamond sparkled on her silver ring.
ex.zh: 她的银戒指上，一颗小钻石闪闪发光。

ex.en: The diamond industry faces growing pressure to demonstrate that its mining practices protect workers and local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 钻石行业面临越来越大的压力，需要证明其采矿活动能够保护工人和当地生态系统。

tip: diamond指金刚石或钻石；菱形的几何术语是rhombus。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A person's worth and right to be treated with respect.
Calm, controlled behaviour that earns respect.

ex.en: The nurse protected his dignity by closing the curtain.
ex.zh: 护士拉上帘子，维护了他的尊严。

ex.en: Care services should preserve the dignity of older people by respecting their privacy and personal choices.
ex.zh: 护理服务应尊重老年人的隐私和个人选择，维护他们的尊严。

col: preserve someone's dignity｜维护某人的尊严
treat someone with dignity｜有尊严地对待某人
tip: 通常不可数；with dignity可表示有尊严地。

senses.en: A particular aspect of a situation, problem, or experience.
A measurement of something, such as its length or width.
An independent direction of measurement, such as length, width, or height.

ex.en: Cooking together added a new dimension to our friendship.
ex.zh: 一起做饭让我们的友谊有了新的层面。

ex.en: Urban planning has a social dimension, since the design of neighbourhoods can influence how frequently residents interact.
ex.zh: 城市规划具有社会层面，因为社区设计会影响居民互动的频率。

col: add a new dimension｜增添新层面
tip: 表示长宽高等具体尺寸时，通常用复数dimensions。

senses.zh: 二氧化物(；编；自制力；纪律；学科；自我控制；管教；处罚

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a list of people or organisations with their contact details
a location used to organise files on a computer

ex.en: I found a nearby plumber in the local directory.
ex.zh: 我在本地名录里找到了一位附近的水管工。

ex.en: An online directory of community services can help new residents locate essential support more easily.
ex.zh: 社区服务在线名录可以帮助新居民更轻松地找到必要的支持。

tip: 名录通常含联系方式；计算机中指文件目录。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Having a condition that limits activities or participation in society.

ex.en: The pool has a lift for disabled swimmers.
ex.zh: 游泳池设有供残障游泳者使用的升降设备。

ex.en: Universities should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support to ensure that disabled students can participate fully in campus life.
ex.zh: 大学应提供无障碍设施和适当支持，确保残障学生能够充分参与校园生活。

col: disabled parking space｜残障人士专用停车位
tip: 可说disabled people或people with disabilities，尊重本人偏好。

senses.en: Controlled behaviour achieved by following rules or managing yourself.
A particular field of study or knowledge.
To punish misconduct or train someone to follow rules.

ex.en: Practising the piano every morning takes patience and discipline.
ex.zh: 每天早晨练钢琴需要耐心和自律。

ex.en: Universities increasingly encourage collaboration between researchers from different disciplines to address complex environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 大学越来越鼓励不同学科的研究人员开展合作，以应对复杂的环境挑战。

col: discipline yourself to do something｜约束自己做某事
tip: 表示纪律通常不可数；表示学科时可数。

senses.en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface
a flat, thin, round object

ex.en: My laptop's disk is almost full of holiday photos.
ex.zh: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。

ex.en: Regular backups protect important research data against accidental deletion and unexpected disk failure in university computer systems.
ex.zh: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。

tip: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

senses.en: to decide something is not worth considering
to officially remove someone from their job
to tell someone or a group they may leave

ex.en: Don't dismiss her idea before you hear the details.
ex.zh: 听完细节之前，别急着否定她的想法。

ex.en: Governments should not dismiss public concerns about the long-term environmental effects of industrial expansion.
ex.zh: 政府不应忽视公众对工业扩张长期环境影响的担忧。

col: dismiss someone from a job｜解雇某人
dismiss something as irrelevant｜认为某事无关而不予考虑
tip: dismiss A as B：认为A是B而不予考虑。

senses.en: The process of getting rid of unwanted things
The state of being available for someone's use

ex.en: The council provides bins for the disposal of batteries.
ex.zh: 市政部门提供专门的回收箱，用于处理废旧电池。

ex.en: Safe waste disposal is essential for protecting groundwater and reducing health risks in densely populated areas.
ex.zh: 安全处置废弃物对于保护地下水和降低人口密集地区的健康风险至关重要。

tip: at someone's disposal 表示供某人使用或支配。

senses.en: the process of giving or delivering things to different people
the way something is spread across an area or group

ex.en: Volunteers organised the distribution of warm blankets after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，志愿者组织发放了保暖毯。

ex.en: The uneven distribution of medical services leaves many rural communities without adequate access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 医疗服务分布不均，导致许多农村社区无法获得充分的医疗保障。

tip: 既指分发过程，也指人口等的分布状态。

senses.en: to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace
to make someone feel worried or upset
to move or change something from its usual position

ex.en: Please close the door quietly so you don't disturb Dad.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门，别打扰爸爸。

ex.en: Construction noise can disturb nearby residents and reduce their quality of life over time.
ex.zh: 施工噪声可能打扰附近居民，并逐渐降低他们的生活质量。

col: disturb someone's sleep｜打扰某人睡眠
tip: disturb强调打扰或使不安；interrupt强调中断。

senses.en: the act of separating something into parts or shares
a major section of a company or organisation
disagreement that separates people into opposing groups

ex.en: We agreed on a fair division of household chores.
ex.zh: 我们就家务的公平分工达成了一致。

ex.en: A clear division of responsibilities between local and national authorities can improve the delivery of public services.
ex.zh: 地方与中央部门之间明确划分职责，可以改善公共服务的提供。

tip: 还可指数学中的除法；divide 是对应动词。

senses.en: Feeling as if you or your surroundings are spinning.

ex.en: I felt dizzy after spinning around with my little cousin.
ex.zh: 和小表弟转了几圈后，我觉得头晕。

ex.en: People who feel dizzy during exercise should stop immediately and seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
ex.zh: 运动时感到头晕的人应立即停下；若症状持续，应咨询医生。

tip: 人作主语用feel dizzy；事物可make人dizzy。

senses.en: a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility
an area controlled by a particular ruler or authority
an internet area identified by a shared name

ex.en: Electrical repairs are my brother's domain, not mine.
ex.zh: 电器维修是我哥哥擅长的领域，不是我的。

ex.en: Environmental protection should not be regarded as the exclusive domain of scientists, since public participation is essential.
ex.zh: 环境保护不应被视为科学家独有的领域，因为公众参与至关重要。

col: the domain of science｜科学领域
tip: 领域义近field；in the public domain指公开可用。

senses.en: More powerful, influential, or noticeable than others.
Expressed when at least one copy of a gene is present.

ex.en: Blue is the dominant colour in our living room.
ex.zh: 蓝色是我们客厅的主色调。

ex.en: Private cars remain the dominant form of transport in cities with limited investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 在公共交通投入有限的城市，私家车仍是主要交通方式。

tip: dominant是形容词；dominate是动词。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a group of twelve
a large unspecified quantity, used in the plural

ex.en: Please buy a dozen eggs on your way home.
ex.zh: 请在回家的路上买十二个鸡蛋。

ex.en: Dozens of community gardens have opened across the city, giving residents more opportunities to grow food.
ex.zh: 全市已开设数十个社区菜园，让居民有更多机会种植食物。

tip: two dozen不加s；dozens of表示许多。

senses.en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort.
To pass or progress so slowly that it feels boring.
A force or influence that slows movement or progress.

ex.en: We dragged the heavy rug across the floor.
ex.zh: 我们拖着沉重的地毯穿过房间。

ex.en: Complicated approval procedures can drag on for months, delaying essential improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 复杂的审批程序可能拖延数月，耽误公共交通的必要改善。

col: a drag on growth｜增长的拖累
tip: drag过去式为dragged；drag on指拖延下去。

senses.en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness.
A substance taken for its effects on mind or body.
To give someone a substance that makes them unconscious or weak.

ex.en: The doctor prescribed a drug to ease her pain.
ex.zh: 医生开了一种药来缓解她的疼痛。

ex.en: New drug development requires extensive testing to ensure that treatments are both safe and effective.
ex.zh: 新药研发需要进行大量测试，以确保治疗既安全又有效。

tip: 可指治病的药，也可指毒品，须看语境。

senses.en: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or float.
To remove dust from a surface.
To cover something lightly with a powder.

ex.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano.
ex.zh: 那架旧钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。

ex.en: Construction dust can reduce local air quality and cause breathing difficulties among nearby residents.
ex.zh: 施工扬尘会降低当地空气质量，并导致附近居民呼吸困难。

col: a layer of dust｜一层灰尘
dust the shelves｜掸去架子上的灰
dust with flour｜撒上少量面粉
tip: dust作动词既可指除尘，也可指撒粉，看宾语判断。

senses.en: Covered with dust or containing a lot of dust.

ex.en: I wiped the dusty shelf with a damp cloth.
ex.zh: 我用湿布擦了擦落满灰尘的架子。

ex.en: Workers in dusty environments need appropriate protective equipment to reduce their risk of developing respiratory diseases.
ex.zh: 在多尘环境中工作的人员需要适当的防护装备，以降低患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: a dusty road｜尘土飞扬的道路
tip: dusty形容有灰尘；dust作动词可表示掸去灰尘。

senses.en: Full of energy and eager to make things happen.
Continuously changing or developing.
A pattern of interaction between people or forces.

ex.en: Our dynamic coach keeps everyone moving throughout the session.
ex.zh: 我们精力充沛的教练让大家整节训练课都保持运动。

ex.en: A dynamic economy requires businesses to adapt quickly to technological advances and changing consumer preferences.
ex.zh: 充满活力的经济需要企业迅速适应技术进步和消费者偏好的变化。

tip: 形容人指有活力；形容系统指不断变化。

senses.en: The study of relationships between living things and their environment.
The relationships between living things and their environment.

ex.en: My sister studies ecology and often visits local wetlands.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习生态学，经常去当地湿地考察。

ex.en: Understanding forest ecology can help governments protect wildlife while managing natural resources more effectively.
ex.zh: 了解森林生态有助于政府在更有效地管理自然资源的同时保护野生动物。

tip: ecology指生态学或生态关系，不等于environment。

senses.en: To become visible or known after being hidden.
To develop or become important and noticeable.

ex.en: A small rabbit emerged from beneath the garden shed.
ex.zh: 一只小兔子从花园棚屋底下钻了出来。

ex.en: New employment opportunities may emerge as governments invest more heavily in renewable energy infrastructure.
ex.zh: 随着政府加大对可再生能源基础设施的投资，新的就业机会可能会出现。

col: emerge as a leader｜崭露头角成为领导者
tip: 不及物动词；常用emerge from或emerge as。

senses.en: A substance released into the environment, especially a polluting gas.
The process of releasing gas, heat, light, or other energy.

ex.en: The mechanic checked my car's emissions this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，修理工检查了我汽车的尾气排放。

ex.en: Governments can reduce carbon emissions by investing in renewable energy and improving public transport networks.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资可再生能源和改善公共交通网络来减少碳排放。

tip: 指废气或排放量常用复数emissions；动词是emit。

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.

ex.en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的雇主允许我每周五在家办公。

ex.en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。

col: a major employer｜大型用人单位
tip: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

senses.en: The ability to continue despite tiredness, pain, or difficulty.

ex.en: Swimming every morning has really improved my endurance.
ex.zh: 每天早晨游泳确实增强了我的耐力。

ex.en: Regular physical activity builds endurance and helps people manage the demands of an increasingly sedentary lifestyle.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强耐力，帮助人们应对日益久坐的生活方式带来的挑战。

col: a test of endurance｜耐力考验
tip: 通常不可数，强调在疲劳或困难中坚持的能力。

senses.en: Improve the quality, value, or appeal of something

ex.en: A little lemon juice enhances the flavour of this soup.
ex.zh: 加一点柠檬汁能让这道汤的味道更好。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can enhance residents' wellbeing and encourage more active lifestyles in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，便利的绿地资源可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更积极的生活方式。

col: enhance the quality of｜改善……的质量
enhance someone's reputation｜提升某人的声誉
tip: 强调质量、效果或价值提升，不单指数量增加。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To give someone the right to have or do something.
To give a name to a book, film, or other work.

ex.en: This ticket entitles you to a free lunch.
ex.zh: 凭这张票，你可以免费享用一顿午餐。

ex.en: Employment laws should entitle all workers to paid leave, regardless of the size of their organisation.
ex.zh: 劳动法应赋予所有劳动者享受带薪休假的权利，无论其所在机构规模大小。

col: entitle someone to benefits｜使某人有资格享受福利
be entitled to compensation｜有权获得赔偿
be entitled to vote｜有权投票
tip: entitle sb to sth或to do sth；常用于被动语态。

senses.en: someone who starts a business and takes financial risks

ex.en: The young entrepreneur opened a bakery near our station.
ex.zh: 那位年轻创业者在我们车站附近开了一家面包店。

ex.en: Local governments can support entrepreneurs by simplifying regulations and improving access to affordable loans.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以通过简化规定、便利获取低息贷款来支持创业者。

col: a successful entrepreneur｜成功的企业家
tip: 强调创办企业并承担风险，不泛指经理。

senses.en: a feeling of wanting something that someone else has
to wish you had another person's possessions, qualities, or advantages
a person or thing that others wish to equal or possess

ex.en: I envy your ability to sleep on noisy trains.
ex.zh: 我真羡慕你能在嘈杂的火车上睡着。

ex.en: Social media can encourage envy by exposing users to carefully selected images of other people's achievements and lifestyles.
ex.zh: 社交媒体让用户接触他人精心挑选的成就和生活方式图片，可能引发羡慕或嫉妒。

col: envy someone something｜羡慕某人拥有某物
the envy of｜令……羡慕的人或事物
tip: 动词直接接宾语：envy someone，不加of。

senses.en: one part of a television or radio series
a particular event or period within a longer story
a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom

ex.en: We watched the final episode together after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们一起看了最后一集。

ex.en: Each episode of the documentary explores how urban development affects wildlife in different parts of the world.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片每一集都探讨城市发展如何影响世界不同地区的野生动物。

col: a brief episode｜一段短暂经历
tip: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。

senses.en: An imaginary line around Earth's middle, equally distant from both poles.

ex.en: Our guide explained why it stays warm near the equator.
ex.zh: 导游解释了为什么赤道附近一直很暖和。

ex.en: Regions near the equator receive intense sunlight throughout the year, contributing to consistently high temperatures.
ex.zh: 赤道附近的地区全年受到强烈的阳光照射，因此气温持续偏高。

col: north of the equator｜赤道以北
tip: 赤道前通常加the；形容词是equatorial。

senses.en: A period distinguished by particular events, developments, or ways of life.

ex.en: These old photographs remind us of a different era.
ex.zh: 这些老照片让我们想起一个不同的时代。

ex.en: The digital era has transformed how people access information, creating both educational opportunities and new inequalities.
ex.zh: 数字时代改变了人们获取信息的方式，既创造了教育机会，也带来了新的不平等。

col: the end of an era｜一个时代的终结
tip: era强调具有共同特征的时代，不指固定年数。

senses.en: moving stairs that carry people between floors

ex.en: Hold the handrail while you ride the escalator upstairs.
ex.zh: 乘自动扶梯上楼时，请扶好扶手。

ex.en: Although escalators improve passenger flow in stations, lifts are essential for travellers who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 尽管自动扶梯能改善车站的客流通行情况，但对使用轮椅的旅客而言，电梯必不可少。

col: an upward escalator｜上行自动扶梯
tip: escalator是自动扶梯；lift是厢式电梯。

senses.en: A large area of owned land, often with a large house.
An area of buildings developed together for a particular purpose.
Everything a person owns, especially after their death.

ex.en: We walked past the lake on the old country estate.
ex.zh: 我们步行经过那座古老乡间庄园里的湖泊。

ex.en: New housing estates should include green spaces and reliable transport links to nearby employment centres.
ex.zh: 新建住宅区应配备绿地，以及通往附近就业中心的可靠交通连接。

tip: real estate指房地产；housing estate指住宅区。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An increase in size, amount, or area

ex.en: The kitchen expansion gave us room for a table.
ex.zh: 厨房扩建后，我们有地方放餐桌了。

ex.en: Rapid urban expansion can threaten nearby farmland unless local authorities introduce effective planning controls.
ex.zh: 如果地方政府不实施有效的规划管控，快速的城市扩张可能威胁周边农田。

tip: 动词是expand，名词拼写变为expansion。

senses.en: An organised journey made for exploration or a specific purpose.
A group of people travelling together to explore or investigate.

ex.en: We packed warm clothes for our expedition into the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们为进山探险打包了保暖衣物。

ex.en: A scientific expedition to the polar regions collected valuable evidence of changes in sea ice.
ex.zh: 一支前往极地的科学考察队收集了海冰变化的重要证据。

col: an expedition to Antarctica｜南极考察
tip: expedition多指有组织、有特定目的的远行。

senses.en: To burst violently, or cause something to burst violently.
To increase extremely quickly in size, amount, or popularity.
To express strong feelings suddenly and forcefully.

ex.en: We watched colourful fireworks explode above the lake.
ex.zh: 我们看着五彩烟花在湖面上空绽放。

ex.en: Demand for online courses has exploded as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop new skills.
ex.zh: 随着更多成年人寻求灵活的机会来培养新技能，在线课程的需求激增。

tip: 爆炸物作主语常用主动形式，不必用被动。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work
Using resources or opportunities to gain an advantage

ex.en: The workers demanded fair wages and protection from exploitation.
ex.zh: 工人们要求合理的工资，并要求得到保护免受剥削。

ex.en: The uncontrolled exploitation of natural resources can damage ecosystems and undermine the livelihoods of communities that depend on them.
ex.zh: 对自然资源的无节制开发会破坏生态系统，并损害依赖这些资源的社区居民的生计。

col: exploitation of natural resources｜自然资源的开发利用
tip: 用于人常指剥削；用于资源指开发利用，需看语境。

senses.en: To make something longer, larger, or wider in scope
To stretch out a hand, arm, or other body part
To offer someone help, an invitation, or a welcome

ex.en: We extended our holiday because the weather was so lovely.
ex.zh: 天气实在太好了，我们便延长了假期。

ex.en: Governments should extend public transport networks to ensure that residents of outer suburbs can access employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府应扩大公共交通网络，确保远郊居民能够获得就业机会。

col: extend a deadline｜延长截止期限
extend a warm welcome｜表示热烈欢迎
tip: extend by接增加量；extend to接新的终点或期限。

senses.en: make an action or process easier

ex.en: These sliding doors facilitate access for people using wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 这些推拉门方便使用轮椅的人进出。

ex.en: Digital platforms can facilitate collaboration between students in different countries, allowing them to exchange ideas more easily.
ex.zh: 数字平台可以促进不同国家学生之间的合作，让他们更容易交流想法。

tip: 后接名词或动名词，不用facilitate somebody to do。

senses.en: The money paid for a journey on public transport.
To perform or experience a particular level of success.
Food of a particular kind served in a place.

ex.en: I had just enough coins for the bus fare.
ex.zh: 我的硬币刚好够付公交车费。

ex.en: Reducing train fares could encourage commuters to leave their cars at home and use public transport.
ex.zh: 降低火车票价可以鼓励通勤者不开车，改用公共交通。

tip: fare是交通票价；fee多指服务费或学费。

senses.en: A barrier enclosing land or separating areas.
To surround or divide an area with a fence.
To fight with special swords as a sport.

ex.en: Our dog watched the neighbours through the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 我们的狗透过木栅栏看着邻居。

ex.en: Installing fences around protected habitats can reduce conflict between local farmers and endangered wildlife.
ex.zh: 在受保护栖息地周围安装围栏，可以减少当地农民与濒危野生动物之间的冲突。

col: put up a fence｜竖起围栏
fence off an area｜用围栏隔开一片区域
tip: sit on the fence比喻保持中立、不表态。

senses.en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back.
To be sold for a particular amount of money.

ex.en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
ex.zh: 你能去卧室把我的夹克拿来吗？

ex.en: Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.
ex.zh: 公共交通便利可靠的地段，住宅往往售价更高，因为买家重视通勤的便利性。

col: fetch someone from school｜去学校接某人
fetch a high price｜卖个高价
tip: fetch强调去后取回；bring只强调带来。

senses.en: the management of money by people, businesses, or governments
money needed to support an activity or project
to provide money for something

ex.en: The bank agreed to finance our new bakery.
ex.zh: 银行同意为我们的新面包店提供资金。

ex.en: Access to affordable finance allows small businesses to invest in equipment and create more local jobs.
ex.zh: 获得成本可承受的资金使小企业能够投资设备并创造更多本地就业机会。

col: finance a project｜为项目提供资金
tip: finance可指资金或金融；个人财务常用finances。

senses.en: A space in a wall where a fire burns.

ex.en: We warmed our feet beside the fireplace after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在壁炉旁暖脚。

ex.en: Traditional homes often feature a fireplace, although modern heating systems are generally more convenient.
ex.zh: 传统住宅通常设有壁炉，不过现代供暖系统一般更方便。

col: light a fire in the fireplace｜在壁炉里生火
tip: 壁炉是fireplace；壁炉架通常叫mantelpiece。

senses.en: a group of ships controlled or operated together
vehicles or aircraft owned or operated by one organisation

ex.en: A fleet of fishing boats returned before sunset.
ex.zh: 一支捕鱼船队在日落前返航了。

ex.en: Replacing the city's ageing bus fleet with electric vehicles could significantly reduce air pollution in residential areas.
ex.zh: 用电动车辆替换该市老旧的公交车队，可以显著减少居民区的空气污染。

col: a fleet of vehicles｜一支车队
tip: 集合名词；a fleet of可接船、车辆或飞机。

senses.zh: 使）快速翻转；（用手指）轻抛

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: having a liking or affection for someone or something
showing or expressing warmth and affection

ex.en: My grandmother is fond of walking by the river.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在河边散步。

ex.en: Many adults retain fond memories of teachers who encouraged their curiosity and supported their ambitions.
ex.zh: 许多成年人仍深情地记得那些激发他们好奇心、支持他们志向的老师。

tip: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

senses.en: A mark left by a foot on a surface.
The amount of ground or space something occupies.
The environmental impact of a person, product, or activity.

ex.en: A muddy footprint covered the clean kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 干净的厨房地板上留下了一个泥脚印。

ex.en: Choosing locally grown food can sometimes reduce the carbon footprint associated with transporting agricultural products.
ex.zh: 选择本地种植的食物有时可以减少运输农产品产生的碳足迹。

tip: carbon footprint指碳排放影响，不是实际脚印。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the way information or an event is arranged or presented
to arrange the appearance of a document or information
to prepare a storage device so it can store data

ex.en: Please send the photos in a different file format.
ex.zh: 请换一种文件格式发送这些照片。

ex.en: Offering course materials in a digital format can make education more accessible to students in remote areas.
ex.zh: 以数字格式提供课程材料，可以让偏远地区的学生更容易获得教育资源。

col: format a document｜设置文档格式
tip: 动词过去式formatted，现在分词formatting。

senses.en: Luckily, especially when something bad could have happened.

ex.en: Fortunately, I found my keys before the bus arrived.
ex.zh: 幸好，我在公交车到站前找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Fortunately, improvements in water treatment have helped many communities reduce the spread of preventable diseases.
ex.zh: 幸运的是，水处理技术的改进帮助许多社区减少了可预防疾病的传播。

col: fortunately for us｜对我们来说幸运的是
fortunately, nobody was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip: 常置于句首，后加逗号，评价整件事令人庆幸。

senses.en: Ancient remains or traces of living things preserved in rock.

ex.en: We found a tiny shell fossil inside the rock.
ex.zh: 我们在岩石里发现了一枚小小的贝壳化石。

ex.en: Fossil evidence helps scientists understand how animals adapted to environmental changes over millions of years.
ex.zh: 化石证据帮助科学家了解动物在数百万年间如何适应环境变化。

tip: fossil fuels指煤、石油、天然气等化石燃料。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a structure that surrounds or supports something
to put a picture or similar object inside a frame
to express or present something in a particular way

ex.en: We chose a wooden frame for our family photograph.
ex.zh: 我们为全家福选了一个木制相框。

ex.en: The way journalists frame environmental issues can influence public attitudes towards conservation and government policy.
ex.zh: 记者呈现环境议题的方式会影响公众对环境保护和政府政策的态度。

col: frame a question｜组织问题的措辞
a frame of reference｜参照体系
tip: frame既可指实体框架，也可指组织表达的方式。

senses.en: The right or ability to act without unnecessary restrictions.
The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.

ex.en: Living alone gives me freedom to choose my own routine.
ex.zh: 独居让我可以自由安排自己的日常生活。

ex.en: Universities should protect academic freedom while encouraging researchers to consider the social consequences of their work.
ex.zh: 大学应保护学术自由，同时鼓励研究人员考虑其工作的社会影响。

tip: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

senses.en: how often something happens within a particular period
the number of wave cycles or vibrations per second

ex.en: The frequency of buses drops sharply after nine each evening.
ex.zh: 每天晚上九点以后，公交车的班次大幅减少。

ex.en: Researchers are examining whether rising ocean temperatures affect the frequency of severe storms in coastal regions.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在考察海洋温度上升是否会影响沿海地区强风暴的发生频率。

col: with increasing frequency｜越来越频繁地
tip: 频率高低用high或low；发生得多不等于速度快。

senses.en: Often or many times

ex.en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
ex.zh: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。

ex.en: People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.
ex.zh: 经常使用公共交通的人，出行开支可能低于每天开车的人。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。
